messages.english: Keep newer crop plans safe when an older app session saves its copy.
messages.translation: Boloka meralo e metjha ya dijalo e sireletsehile ha seshene ya kgale ya sesebediswa e boloka kopi ya yona.

messages.english: Review retained copies before continuing with your current crop plan.
messages.translation: Hlahloba dikopi tse bolokilweng pele o tswela pele ka moralo wa hao wa hona jwale wa dijalo.

messages.english: Retry interrupted guest crop transfers without replacing saved account work.
messages.translation: Leka hape phetisetso e sitisehileng ya mosebetsi wa dijalo wa moeti ntle le ho nkela mosebetsi o bolokilweng wa akhaonte sebaka.
Hlahloba polokelo ya moralo wa dijalo
Moralo wa tlhahiso → Polokelo ya moralo wa dijalo

messages.english: Check the storage notice. If an older session changed its copy, download both copies and review them before choosing to keep your current plan.
messages.translation: Sheba tsebiso ya polokelo. Haeba seshene ya kgale e fetotse kopi ya yona, jarolla dikopi ka bobedi mme o di hlahlobe pele o kgetha ho boloka moralo wa hao wa hona jwale.
